description: This course is a follow-up to the basic programming methodology course. It explores two modern programming paradigms - object-oriented programming and functional programming. Through a series of integrated assignments, students will learn to develop medium-scale software programmes using object-oriented design principles and advanced programming constructs available in the two paradigms. Topics include objects and classes, composition, association, inheritance, interface, polymorphism, abstract classes, dynamic binding, generics, exception handling, lambda expression, side effect-free programming, first-class functions, closures, continuations, monad, etc.
